name: reel-social-agent
description: Automated agent producing True-WTF micro-documentary reels and pushing them to TikTok drafts

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,front,captions -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @reel-agent/api dev" "pnpm --filter @reel-agent/frontend dev" "pnpm --filter @reel-agent/captions dev"
scripts.tts:calibrate: cd services/tts && uv run --python .venv python scripts/calibrate.py
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @reel-agent/shared build && pnpm --filter @reel-agent/api build && pnpm --filter @reel-agent/frontend build && pnpm --filter @reel-agent/captions build
scripts.prompt:critique: cd api && pnpm exec tsx --env-file=.env scripts/prompt-critique.mts
scripts.prompt:eval: cd api && RUN_EVAL=1 pnpm exec vitest run tests/storyEval.test.ts
scripts.prompt:rescore: cd api && pnpm exec tsx scripts/eval-rescore.mts
scripts.recut: cd api && pnpm exec tsx --env-file=.env scripts/recut.mts
scripts.fal:schema: cd api && pnpm exec tsx scripts/fal-schema.ts
scripts.cursor:models: cd api && pnpm exec tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/cursor-models.mts
